about: Bugs seeded into Harbor Vault. All are on by default; ?bugs=none turns them off and ?bugs=1,4 turns on a subset. Addresses are in site/public/deployments.json.

bugs.title: Approve button says "Approve <amount> hUSDC" but requests an unlimited approval
bugs.flow: Deposit hUSDC into the vault (approve step)
bugs.detect: Compare the button label with the wallet request: approve(HarborVault, 2^256-1) instead of approve(HarborVault, amount * 10^6).

bugs.title: "Claim rewards" first asks to approve hUSDC to the Helper contract
bugs.detect: The first wallet request is approve(Helper, claimable) on hUSDC. The spender is neither the vault nor the RewardsDistributor, has no verified source, and the button only said "Claim rewards".

bugs.title: After rejecting the deposit in the wallet, the Deposit button stays on "Confirming…" forever
bugs.detect: Reject eth_sendTransaction for deposit(); the button stays disabled with "Confirming…" and no message, so the user cannot retry without reloading.

bugs.title: No network check: on the wrong chain the deposit is sent anyway
bugs.detect: With the wallet on another chain (e.g. 1), no wrong-network banner and no wallet_switchEthereumChain; eth_sendTransaction is sent while the wallet reports the other chain, and the UI then waits forever for a receipt.

bugs.title: Account switch is ignored: header keeps the old address and balance, next tx uses the stale from
bugs.flow: Any transaction after switching account (e.g. faucet, deposit)
bugs.detect: Emit accountsChanged with a new account; the header still shows the previous address/balance and the next eth_sendTransaction has from = the previous account.

bugs.title: Withdraw with too little ETH for gas throws an uncaught error and the page goes blank
bugs.detect: Drain the account's ETH and withdraw: an uncaught TypeError ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'errorName')") and #root is empty. Expected: a "Not enough ETH to pay for gas" message.

bugs.title: Under slow RPC the Deposit button isn't disabled while pending, so a second click sends a second deposit
bugs.detect: Delay the page's RPC (~1.5s) and click Deposit twice: two deposit() eth_sendTransaction requests reach the wallet.

bugs.title: "Sign in" says "Sign in to Harbor Vault" but requests an EIP-712 Permit for hUSDC to the Helper
bugs.detect: The dialog promises a free sign-in message, but the wallet gets eth_signTypedData_v4 with primaryType Permit on hUSDC, spender = Helper, value = 2^256-1. Expected: personal_sign of a SIWE-style message.

bugs.title: With two wallets installed it always uses window.ethereum instead of the wallet the user picked
bugs.detect: Announce two wallets, with only the first as window.ethereum; pick the second in the modal. eth_requestAccounts (and every later request) goes to the first wallet, while the UI names the second.
